lessons.title: B2 Listening: Short Monologues & Gist Identification
grammar: Modals of deduction in past and present (must have, might be)
Reported speech with complex reporting verbs
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-001"
cando: "Can identify main feelings, gist, and context in short B2 monologues."
strategy: "Timing: 1 min per clip. Pitfall: Fixating on unknown vocabulary instead of overall tone. Criteria: Accurate attitude and feeling identification."
lessons.recycled: Foundational communication & basic level vocabulary

lessons.title: B2 Listening: Multi-Speaker Conversations & Attitude
grammar: Mixed conditionals (If I had studied..., I would be...)
Wish / If only for past regrets
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-002"
cando: "Can track opinions, agreement, and skepticism across multi-speaker discussions."
strategy: "Timing: 3 mins dialogue duration. Pitfall: Missing subtle vocal inflection signals of irony or doubt. Criteria: Distinguishing explicit vs implicit agreement."
lessons.recycled: Modals of deduction in past and present, Reported speech, Gist, Attitude

lessons.title: B2 Listening: Sentence Completion & Technical Detail
grammar: Passive voice in complex tenses (has been demonstrated)
Noun clauses as direct objects
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-003"
cando: "Can extract exact terms from an informational talk to complete gapped sentences."
strategy: "Timing: 8 mins talk duration. Pitfall: Changing the word form when copying target terms from audio. Criteria: Exact lexical and grammatical accuracy in gap fill."
lessons.recycled: Mixed conditionals, Wish / If only, Disagreement, Skeptical

lessons.title: B2 Listening: Extended Interview & Speaker Perspective
grammar: Relative clauses with prepositions (in which, to whom)
Cleft sentences for emphasis (What surprised me was...)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-004"
cando: "Can follow a 10-minute radio interview and evaluate speaker motivations and insights."
strategy: "Timing: 10 mins interview duration. Pitfall: Selecting options based on words used by interviewer rather than interviewee. Criteria: Accurate attribution of stance to correct speaker."
lessons.recycled: Passive voice in complex tenses, Noun clauses, Research, Findings

lessons.title: B2 Listening: Audio Strategy Review & Distractor Avoidance
grammar: Synthesis of B2 listening structures
Advanced connectors of contrast (whereas, while, nevertheless)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-005"
cando: "Can complete a full B2 listening paper with high accuracy and distractor resistance."
strategy: "Timing: 40 mins total test duration. Pitfall: Falling for options that restate audio words in negated contexts. Criteria: Mastery over paraphrase recognition and distractor traps."
lessons.recycled: Relative clauses with prepositions, Cleft sentences, Interviewee, Insight

units.title: B2 Reading Comprehension & Use of English

lessons.title: B2 Reading: Multiple Matching & Text Scanning
grammar: Conditionals with provided that / as long as
Participle clauses (Having finished the report...)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-006"
cando: "Can scan multiple short texts or paragraphs to locate specific detailed claims."
strategy: "Timing: 15 mins for 10 matching items. Pitfall: Reading entire texts line-by-line instead of targeted scanning. Criteria: Speed scanning and paraphrase matching."
lessons.recycled: Synthesis of B2 listening structures, Advanced connectors of contrast, Distractor, Paraphrase

lessons.title: B2 Reading: Gapped Text & Structural Cohesion
grammar: Pronoun reference (this, such, former, latter)
Inversion with negative adverbials (Little did he know)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-007"
cando: "Can insert missing sentences into an article based on structural and cohesive clues."
strategy: "Timing: 12 mins for 6 gaps. Pitfall: Checking only the sentence before the gap and ignoring the sentence after. Criteria: Paragraph cohesion and discourse marker tracking."
lessons.recycled: Conditionals with provided that, Participle clauses, Excerpt, Cross-reference

lessons.title: B2 Reading: Long Article & Writer's Opinion
grammar: Advanced passive constructions (It is understood that)
Subjunctive and hypothetical structures
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-008"
cando: "Can analyze a 700-word article to answer detailed multiple-choice questions on tone and stance."
strategy: "Timing: 15 mins total. Pitfall: Choosing options that reflect text mention but miss the main argument. Criteria: In-depth textual comprehension."
lessons.recycled: Pronoun reference, Inversion with negative adverbials, Cohesion, Transition

lessons.title: B2 Use of English: Open Cloze & Word Formation
grammar: Prefixes and suffixes for word formation (un-, dis-, -tion, -ity)
Dependent prepositions and fixed phrasal verbs
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-009"
cando: "Can complete open cloze and word formation tasks testing grammar and derivative accuracy."
strategy: "Timing: 10 mins for open cloze + word formation. Pitfall: Forgetting negative prefixes (e.g. un-, im-) when meaning demands opposite. Criteria: Morphological and grammatical accuracy."
lessons.recycled: Advanced passive constructions, Subjunctive structures, Perspective, Argument

grammar: Key word transformations involving conditionals, passives, and modals
Verb-noun collocations (take into account, make an attempt)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B2-010"
cando: "Can rewrite sentences using a given key word without altering original meaning (2-5 words)."
strategy: "Timing: 12 mins for 6 transformations. Pitfall: Exceeding 5 words or changing the key word form. Criteria: Exact semantic equivalence and grammatical constraint compliance."
lessons.recycled: Prefixes and suffixes for word formation, Dependent prepositions, Derivation, Prefix
